subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw core define a stable per-user accounting subject and viewer authorization model for usage reporting now, or should user-dimensional billing/quota reporting wait for the broader Gateway principal/authorship work?
rationale: Current source has local usage totals and some origin metadata, but no canonical identity, retention, aggregation, or authorization contract for billing-grade per-user views.

options.title: Define core accounting subject first
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer permission model, then extend the usage RPCs/UI around that contract.

options.title: Wait for principal/authorship threads
options.body: Keep this issue open but block implementation until the Gateway multi-token and per-message author attribution designs settle.

options.title: Plugin or external only for now
options.body: Document current usage exports and plugin diagnostics as the supported path for custom per-user spend dashboards until core has multi-user direction.

recommendation.title: Define core accounting subject first
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer permission model, then extend the usage RPCs/UI around that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history signal across usage RPC/UI and is already the prior routing owner for this product/security decision.
